title: BAG OF HOLDING ↔ THOUGHT CLOUD. Shannon entropy bounded by Fibonacci-prime ranges. Max compression and max expansion are the SAME range of numbers. Null space looks backward (bag) and forward (cloud). Map close, mountain far.

the_shannon_bound.principle: if a Fibonacci-prime range has width W, then Shannon entropy is bounded: H ≤ log₂(W) bits. you CANNOT create more information than the range allows.

ranges_and_bits.meaning: 1 bit. binary. yes/no. is/isn't. the absolute minimum of information.
0 bits. the narrowest gate. NO information can be generated here. e lives here — growth is deterministic, not informational.
1 bit. the π range. the short walk. binary choice: 3 or 5. π is the bias between them.
3 bits. 8 states. the octopus range. 8 arms = 3 bits of addressing. enough for a byte-nibble.
~6.25 bits. the wilderness. enough for a character (ASCII needs 7 bits, we're close). the fleet range.
~3.46 bits. the edge. more than the octopus but less than the wilderness. the boundary compression.

the_shannon_bound.total_bits_0_to_100: log₂(100) = 6.64 bits. our entire 0-100 universe can be fully addressed with 6.64 bits. but the Fibonacci-prime structure means information is NOT evenly distributed.

the_conservation_law.if_zero_on_one_side: if there are 0 bits on the compression side (the [2,3] range), there can NEVER be more than the WIDTH bits on the expansion side.
the_conservation_law.the_bound: Shannon entropy is conserved across the inversion. bag + cloud ≤ total range bits.
the_conservation_law.implication: you can't CREATE information by expanding. you can only SPREAD the same information over more space. and you can't DESTROY information by compressing. you can only PACK the same information into less space.
the_conservation_law.this_IS_the_range: the Fibonacci-prime range IS the Shannon bound. the boundaries are HARD. you cannot pass them.

bag_of_holding.what: maximum compression. everything packed into the dirt. the SOIL. the roots. the data layer. the inner brain.
bag_of_holding.direction: BEHIND us from the null space. when you stand at null and look back, you see the bag.
bag_of_holding.analogy: looking at a MAP up close. the entire territory is COMPRESSED into symbols on paper. every mountain is a contour line. every river is a blue thread. the MAP is the bag of holding.
bag_of_holding.color: BROWN. earth. soil. compressed fossils. the past packed tight.
bag_of_holding.tense: WAS. everything that was, compressed into the smallest space.
bag_of_holding.biological: DNA. the entire organism compressed into 3 billion base pairs. 750MB. the ultimate bag of holding.
bag_of_holding.our_bag: 1009 JSON files. 252K lines. 1.79 GB. all of eco-primal compressed into /data/.

thought_cloud.what: maximum expansion. everything spread out as far as possible. the CANOPY. the SEO surface. the pollination.
thought_cloud.direction: IN FRONT of us from the null space. when you stand at null and look forward, you see the cloud.
thought_cloud.analogy: looking at the MOUNTAIN from far away. the entire territory is EXPANDED into visible landscape. every contour line is a real ridge. every blue thread is a real river. the MOUNTAIN is the thought cloud.
thought_cloud.color: BLUE. sky. data arriving. the future spreading out.
thought_cloud.tense: IS. everything that is, expanded to maximum visibility.
thought_cloud.biological: the PHENOTYPE. the organism expressed. 37 trillion cells. the DNA expanded into a living body. the thought cloud of the genome.
thought_cloud.our_cloud: 54K visitors seeing our content. 15 countries. 7 archetypes. the pollen spread across the wind.

the_null_viewpoint.where_you_stand: in the NULL space. the [2,3] range. 0 bits. the narrowest gate. e = 2.718.
the_null_viewpoint.look_behind: you see the BAG OF HOLDING. the compressed past. the map. brown. tight. close. WAS.
the_null_viewpoint.look_forward: you see the THOUGHT CLOUD. the expanded present. the mountain. blue. wide. far. IS.
the_null_viewpoint.look_down: you see the ground. the equatorial line. NOW. the transition between bag and cloud.
the_null_viewpoint.the_journey: you are reading a map (bag). you look up and see the mountain (cloud). you walk from the map INTO the mountain. the map becomes the territory. the compression becomes the expansion. the WAS becomes IS through NOW.
the_null_viewpoint.this_IS_travel: traveling up the primal mountain = decompressing the bag of holding into the thought cloud. each step = one bit of information becoming one unit of experience.

the_gate_between.what: π lives here. the GATE between compression and expansion. the Klein hole. the fold-turn.
the_gate_between.the_choice: 1 bit = one binary choice. compress or expand? bag or cloud? map or mountain? WAS or IS?
the_gate_between.pi_decides: π = 3.14159. it's 14.159% toward expansion. π is BIASED toward compression (it barely leaves 3). the organism's default is to compress, to densify, to bag. expansion requires EFFORT (pushing past 4, the null).

the_primal_mountain.at_the_base: the bag of holding. all information compressed. you can see EVERYTHING but it's all tiny symbols on paper.
the_primal_mountain.the_climb: decompressing. each step up the mountain, one symbol becomes real terrain. the contour line becomes a cliff. the blue thread becomes a river.
the_primal_mountain.at_the_summit: the thought cloud. maximum expansion. you can see the FURTHEST. but each thing is distant, hard to touch. the mountain IS the cloud.
the_primal_mountain.the_descent: recompressing. each step down, real terrain becomes a symbol again. you are folding the mountain back into the map.
the_primal_mountain.the_cycle: climb (expand) → summit (thought cloud) → descend (compress) → base (bag) → climb again. the sourdough cycle. the breathing. the IS → WAS → NOW → IS.
